title: Design, price and sell your knit and crochet line

say: Design, price and sell your knit and crochet line.
This is the video for module five of Advanced Knitting and Crochet.
Skill alone does not pay. In most of Nigeria the weather is warm for much of the year, so bags, homeware, baby items, light tops and gifts usually sell more steadily than heavy jumpers.

say: Cotton is breathable and absorbent, good for bags, dishcloths and baby items. Linen blends are cool and crisp. Viscose blends drape well for lace scarves and flowing tops.

panel.heading: Match fibre to product and climate
items: Cotton: bags, dishcloths, baby items
Linen blends: light tops, table runners
Viscose blends: lace scarves, flowing tops
Acrylic: toys, bags, cushions
Wool: harmattan accessories

say: Acrylic is affordable and colourfast, good for toys and cushions, but it is not breathable and melts under a hot iron. Wool is warm, best for harmattan accessories.

say: Market yarn is not always labelled. A burn test tells you the fibre family. Snip about 5 cm, and hold it with metal tweezers, never fingers, over a bowl of water.
Work away from fabrics and gas cylinders, never near a stove in use, ventilate the room, and keep children away.

panel.heading: A safe burn test for unlabelled yarn
items: Snip about 5 cm of yarn
Hold with metal tweezers over water
Paper smell, soft grey ash: plant fibre
Hair smell, puts itself out: wool
Melts to a hard bead: synthetic
panel.rule: Short snip, metal tweezers, over water. Children away.

say: Cotton, linen and viscose smell like burning paper and leave soft grey ash. Wool smells like burning hair and puts itself out. Synthetics melt into a hard bead, and can drip and burn skin.

say: Instead of making one of everything, choose a few products at three levels. For example, Tolu in Abeokuta plans a collection for weddings, naming ceremonies and gifts.

say: Her good item is a coaster set that takes about 1 hour and brings new customers in. Her better item, the main seller, is a tapestry pouch. Her best is a custom baby blanket with the baby's initial.

say: She uses one colour story, cream, mustard and indigo, so her photos look professional together. And she writes a product card for each, with yarn, hook, grams, time and size, so the 20th pouch matches the first.

say: Handmade work is often underpriced because the maker counts only the yarn. A fair price covers materials, your time, a share of running costs, and profit.
Mercy's yarn costs about 2,500 naira per 100 g ball, so 25 naira per gram. Her 180 g cost 4,500, plus 500 for a tag and packaging.
Her time is 10.5 hours at 800 naira an hour: 8,400.
She adds 10 percent overhead, and 25 percent profit.
That is 18,425 naira, which she rounds to 18,500 as her wholesale price.
Markup is profit as a percentage of cost. Mercy added 25 percent.

cards.d: Profit as a percentage of cost. Mercy's 3,685 profit is 25% of her cost.
Profit as a percentage of price: 20%. A 20% discount would wipe out all her profit.
Shop keeps 30%? Divide by 0.7. 18,500 / 0.7 means a shop price of about 26,500.

say: Margin is profit as a percentage of the selling price. Her margin is 20 percent, so a 20 percent discount would wipe out all her profit. Always check discounts against margin.

cards.d: Profit as a percentage of cost. Mercy's 3,685 profit is 25% of her cost.
Profit as a percentage of price: 20%. A 20% discount would wipe out all her profit.
Shop keeps 30%? Divide by 0.7. 18,500 / 0.7 means a shop price of about 26,500.

say: In consignment, a shop pays you only after an item sells, and keeps a commission. If it keeps 30 percent, divide your wholesale price by 0.7. The shop price should be at least about 26,500 naira. Agree the terms in writing.

say: The buyer cannot touch the yarn, so your photo must do that work. Shoot near a window in daylight, on a plain background, with the flash off.
Take a set: the whole item, a close-up of the stitches, the item in use, and one with a ruler for size.

say: Your listing should answer size, fibre, care, price, delivery and lead time, so buyers stop asking the same five questions.

say: Fake transfer alerts and edited screenshots are common tricks. Confirm every payment in your own bank or wallet app before you dispatch, and never share an OTP, PIN or password.
Then pack neatly, add a tag and care card, and send a thank-you message.

say: To remember. Choose cotton and plant blends for warm weather. Burn test safely, over water. Build a good, better, best ladder in one colour story. Price with materials, labour, overhead and profit. And dispatch only after the payment shows in your own app.
